## Tutorial exports

- Include export presets in the standalone tutorial download for Web, Windows, Linux, macOS, Android and iOS.
- Enable GDExtensions in the Web preset, with threads disabled, so the bundled GDScript implementation can run in the browser.
- Add browser playback checks covering all five lessons in both C# and GDScript, in Debug and Release.

For .NET web builds, use [2dog 4.7.2.107](https://github.com/outfox/2dog/releases/tag/v4.7.2.107) or later, with native packages 4.7.2.20 or later. This fixes imports and packaging being redirected by `GODOT_EDITOR`, and selects matching Debug or Release GDExtension libraries. Update existing 2dog projects with `dnx 2dog update`, then publish the web host again.

## Downloads

- **Godot addon:** `tweens.gd-0.1.8-beta.zip` includes C# and GDScript sources, stable UIDs, and prebuilt native libraries. Requires Godot 4.7 or later (tested with 4.7.2); C# additionally requires Godot .NET and .NET 8 or later. GDScript-only projects do not require .NET.
- **Standalone tutorial:** `tweens.gd-tutorial.zip` includes the complete tutorial project, export presets and the 0.1.8-beta addon. Requires Godot .NET 4.7.2 and the .NET 8 SDK or later.
- **Compiled C# package:** `tweens.gd.0.1.8-beta.nupkg`, targeting .NET 8 and .NET 10, with symbols in `tweens.gd.0.1.8-beta.snupkg`.

**Full changelog:** [v0.1.7-beta…v0.1.8-beta](https://github.com/outfox/tweens.gd/compare/v0.1.7-beta...v0.1.8-beta)
